observedConflictBehavior: Refuse append if second read differs; refuse restore if current is neither exact snapshot nor exact appended list. Never overwrite observed foreign changes.
privacy: Original user paths only live in parent memory and private child argv; private stdout/stderr suppressed, list setter argv redacted in RECORDS. Other keychain contents/credentials never read. Metadata counts only are public.
limits: Public search-list setter has no CAS: a same-user writer between check and set can race. This candidate is disposable hosted-Mac-only and never asserts atomic cross-process exclusion.

SIGKILL/host crash can prevent finally; on observed restore conflict the producer fails and reports possible search-list remainder rather than overwriting foreign state. Owned private keychain deletion is still attempted.
No Mac security/codesign/SDK execution on this local machine; actual root-controlled finite Mac run is required. No new fallback/adhoc signing or weaker CMS/profile/MachO gate.
